4316-4885-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

147-997-3905.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-997-3905.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

728-2158-3249-5004.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-3249-5004.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cathodion, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Cathodion from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

3558-3899-4053-6989.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

640-1981-2415-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.
640-1981-2415-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

360-1981-2415-5256.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
360-1981-2415-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2557-4772-5478-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
2557-4772-5478-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

821-5220-6900-7492.description:
Cast Mogg Fanatic by paying its mana cost.
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2493-6259.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2493-6259.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2493-6259.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4565-4762-7741.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Ozolith, the Shattered Spire and Shang-Chi.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

3532-5078-6769-7692.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3532-5078-6769-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

2047-5471.notablePrerequisites:
Obeka's power is greater than or equal to 8 minus the number of artifacts you control that share a name with the artifact that has Mechanized Production attached.
An opponent cannot block Obeka.
2047-5471.description:
Deal combat damage using Obeka, triggering Obeka, causing you to get that many upkeep steps after this phase.
Move to your next upkeep step. At the beginning of that step, Mechanized Production triggers, causing you to create a token copy of the artifact it's attached to, and win the game if you control eight or more artifacts that share a name.
Repeat step 2 as necessary for the remaining upkeep steps until you win the game.

933-1558-6741.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five multicolored permanents.
933-1558-6741.description:
Cast Infinite Guideline Station either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Infinite Guideline Station's station ability by tapping any number of creatures with total power 12 or greater, putting at least twelve charge counters on Infinite Guideline Station, causing it to become a creature.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Robots, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Infinite Guideline Station.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

141-1269-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1269-6797.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3277-3647-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
3277-3647-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Izzet Chronarch and Peregrine Drake
When Izzet Chronarch and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
3277-3647-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

1894-2173-2842-5220.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1409-3875-5478-6839.description:
Activate Ignis by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ignis enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ignis.
Resolve the Ignis trigger, causing you to look at the top six cards of your library and put a land card from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Treasure token. Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.
1409-3875-5478-6839.notes: This combo can fail if Ignis does not reveal a land. You can use additional mana to restart the combo if desired should this happen. The combo also assumes every land you grab will be mana-producing.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya

225-573-5449-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
225-573-5449-5702.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-573-5449-5702.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Gruul Turf.
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

280-5451-5702-6763.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
280-5451-5702-6763.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

145-1174-6678.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
145-1174-6678.description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Talon Gates of Madara's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning Talon Gates of Madara from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Serra's Sanctum.
Activate Talon Gates of Madara's third ability by paying {4}, putting it from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Talon Gates of Madara enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out up to one target creature.
Repeat.

813-3306-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
813-3306-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng and Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2281-2292-3175.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1329-2047-3169-4050.easyPrerequisites: Mechanized Production attached to Genesis Chamber.
1329-2047-3169-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of artifacts equal to or greater than two plus Emry's commander tax.
1329-2047-3169-4050.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of Genesis Chamber.
Cast Emry from the command zone by paying {U}.
When Emry enters the battlefield, it and both Genesis Chambers trigger.
Resolve the Emry trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
Resolve both Genesis Chamber triggers, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emry, adding {U}.
Choose to return Emry to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.

2981-3604-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue token.
2981-3604-5365.description:
Cast Lonis by paying {1}{G/U}{G/U}.
When Lonis enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Lonis.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.
2981-3604-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

710-3055-5686.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Danitha.
710-3055-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

586-5231-5626-5687.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {R}.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

24-5644-5755.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}.
Judith triggers, giving Wheel of Misfortune deathtouch and lifelink.
Resolve Wheel of Misfortune, choosing an arbitrarily large number.
If you didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals damage equal to the highest number chosen to each player that chose it, causing those players to lose the game due to having 0 or less life.
If you chose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals that much damage to you and causes you to gain that much life.
Enduring Tenacity triggers, causing an opponent to lose lfie equal to the life you gained.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1432-2821-3201-5259.notablePrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House, Arixmethes and Minamo do not have summoning sickness.
1432-2821-3201-5259.description:
Cast Rude Awakening by paying {4}{G}, causing all lands you control to become 2/2 creatures that are still lands until end of turn.
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House's second ability by tapping it, untapping Minamo and Arixmethes.
Repeat from step 2.

856-2292-4321-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2292-4321-5477.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 green Plant creature token and a Food artifact token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

262-1379-1558.notablePrerequisites: Elemental Mastery attached to a creature you control that has power 5 or greater and that does not have summoning sickness.
262-1379-1558.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating at least five 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Elemental tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2947-4881-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Vesperlark.
When Vesperlark dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Activated Sleeper.
When Activated Sleeper dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.

2424-2649.notablePrerequisites:
You own and control a non-Human creature.
You do not own any non-Human creatures controlled by another player.
2424-2649.description:
Cast Vadrok for its Mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Chef's Kiss by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting the Vadrok spell.
Resolve Chef's Kiss, creating a copy of the Vadrok spell that will target your non-Human creature due to your opponent not controlling any legal targets.
Vadrok's mutate ability triggers, causing you to cast Chef's Kiss from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
For each time a Vadrok has mutated on top of this creature, Vadrok's mutate ability triggers, causing you to cast any number of noncreature cards with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard.

1000-1068-4656.manaNeeded: {6}{W}{U}, plus {1} if Mystic Reflection was not foretold
1000-1068-4656.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
Leveler enters the battlefield, triggering itself, exiling your library.
Cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Leveler.
Cast Alliance of Arms by paying {W}, paying at least {1} as it resolves and causing each player to create a number of Leveler tokens equal to the amount of mana paid.
Each of the token copies of Leveler enter the battlefield, triggering themselves, exiling their controllers' libraries.

1335-2313-2744-5296.notablePrerequisites:
Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
Workhorse has at least one +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2313-2744-5296.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Elemental token.
Cathars' Crusade triggers putting two +1/+1 counter to all creatures you control.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4377-4560.description:
Pay {2}{U/R} {U/R} to activate Soulfire Grand Master's ability.
Pay {4}{U}{U} to cast Walk the Aeons.
Soulfire Grand Master's ability triggers, returning Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Pass to extra turn.
Repeat for infinite turns.

524-4810.description:
Cast Aether Storm.
Players can no longer cast creature spells, and Aether Storm can not be destroyed due to players being unable to pay life to activate its ability
